7 Brew Salted Caramel Macchiato: Price, Calories & Caffeine

A medium Salted Caramel Macchiato is about $4.95, with 330 calories, 120 mg of caffeine and 48 g of sugar. Every number here comes from 7 Brew's own published nutrition guide, broken out by size and preparation.

Salted Caramel Macchiato at a glance

Price (estimate)$4.25$4.95$5.75
Calories250330370
Caffeine120 mg120 mg240 mg
Sugar42 g48 g51 g

Calories, caffeine and sugar are from the official guide. Prices are researched estimates for a classic espresso drink and vary by market.

Is there a sugar-free Salted Caramel Macchiato?

Yes — 7 Brew lists a sugar-free version built with sugar-free syrups. Comparing mediums (iced):

VersionCaloriesSugarCarbsCaffeine
Salted Caramel Macchiato33048 g51 g120 mg
Sugar-free Salted Caramel Macchiato21013 g24 g120 mg

Caffeine does not change — only the syrup does. See every sugar-free option in the customization guide.

Salted Caramel Macchiato allergens

7 Brew's published allergen guide lists Milk for the Salted Caramel Macchiato. Adding a milk, syrup or topping changes this, and every drink is made on shared equipment, so cross-contact is possible.

If you are ordering around an allergy, check the full allergen and dietary guide and confirm at the window.

How to order a Salted Caramel Macchiato

Ask for it by name — it is on the standard board at every 7 Brew, so no special script is needed. Say the size first, then the drink: "Can I get a medium Salted Caramel Macchiato?"

Worth knowing before you order: the base is customisable. You can swap milk, ask for sugar-free syrups, change the sweetness level, or have most drinks made iced, hot or blended as a frozen chiller where the menu allows. Ordering through the app earns 100 rewards points either way.

7 Brew Salted Caramel Macchiato FAQ

How many calories are in a 7 Brew Salted Caramel Macchiato?

A medium iced Salted Caramel Macchiato has 330 calories. A small has 250 and a large 370, according to 7 Brew's nutrition guide.

How much caffeine is in a 7 Brew Salted Caramel Macchiato?

About 120 mg in a medium. Small is 120 mg and large is 240 mg.

How much does a 7 Brew Salted Caramel Macchiato cost?

Roughly $4.25 for a small, $4.95 for a medium and $5.75 for a large. Prices are our estimates and vary by stand — every 7 Brew is independently owned.

How much sugar is in a 7 Brew Salted Caramel Macchiato?

48 g in a medium, or 13 g if you order the sugar-free version.
